definition_of_done: The three named monitor cards open list rows computed by exactly the same in-memory predicates as their displayed metric values; no generic confirmed-order substitution.
A selected row opens its existing record in the existing inspector with no new network endpoint, policy bypass, write action, hidden record ID or fabricated source fact.
Back/close restores the exact monitor-origin list and then the monitor; stale, denied, context-drift and unavailable states fail closed and discard the trail rather than showing prior-access records.
The implementation remains read-only in monitor context. It does not claim that an in-place list proves an end-to-end action, branch/period contract, cross-role behavior or full UXD-02 acceptance.
Author provides exact diff and generated artifact provenance; independent reviewer verifies source pin, predicate equality, trail invalidation and allowlist before root integration.
required_validation_after_review_not_run: Static review of exact predicate equality, policy/role preservation, trail invalidation and generated artifact provenance.

A separately authorized focused synthetic presentation check may be classified NEW only after reviewer confirms it is not the completed UXD01 AST disclosure problem; it must have its own cap and preserve raw output.
A browser/accessibility check is a separate future scope and remains constrained by GATE-10/A11; it is not implied by static or focused validation.
historical_qa_limits: Do not consume or reset B30-12 fixture/training/progress exception; it remains SAME-PROBLEM awaiting owner decision.
Do not repeat P05, A09 targeted payload, A10 upgrade/rollback or A11 browser/loopback routes.
UXD01 AST run1 FAIL and run2 PASS are retained disclosure-oracle history; they do not authorize a repeat or prove this contextual drilldown.
known_risks: The existing inspector's order trace can independently reread sources; the card must distinguish that later guarded read from the snapshot list and preserve fail-closed stale handling.
Nested source links need a bounded monitor-origin trail so returning does not display an object after access/context changes.
Task and receivable metrics remain excluded until their differing record/reconciliation contracts are independently scoped; expanding them would make the metric/list equivalence untrue.
